decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-c6506d0df552] is a one-line release-note entry. It names an end-to-end test (TestCompositionRevisionSelection, marked with the "e2e:" prefix) and says the test now waits for the correct package. It names no product field, flag, API, default or behaviour. That is enough to record this as a test-only change: no operator-facing subject, no typed change, no exposed environments and no consequence for operators who do nothing. That conclusion is drawn from the "e2e:" label and the test name, not from an explicit "no user impact" statement, so confidence is low.
